entities.name: Max de Crinis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Professor Maximinus Friedrich Alexander de Crinis held a chair in psychiatry in Cologne and at Charité in Berlin, and was a medical expert for the Action T4 Euthanasia Program who wrote the Euthanasia Decree, signed by Adolf Hitler on 20 September 1939.
